action_basis.inherited_actions: discharged inductively by the previously established lower-level factorisation when that factorisation remains valid
action_basis.new_layer_action: existing pairwise RELATION_ADD between two distinct current-level owners using the frozen compatible endpoint-type pairs

construction_sampling.policy: choose a canonical exact pointed-orbit representative for construction only
construction_sampling.purpose: build one reproducible exact representative for each frozen scout motif without using the inherited quotient as the state
construction_sampling.scientific_firewall: all legal pointed endpoint orbits are enumerated in the factorisation audit; the construction sampling choice is not the action law

exactness_boundary.meaning: O7 retained E7 incidence and every new O8+ relation/reservation are preserved explicitly. Hidden pre-O7 topology already discarded by the compact O6 resource carrier is not reconstructed or invented.
exactness_boundary.reopen: If pre-O7 hidden topology is required for a candidate separator, request the historical archive and rebuild from the earliest exact carrier that preserves it.

factorisation_test.compute: enumerate the legal current-level action relation on exact H_n, including exact pointed endpoint-orbit multiplicity; then map every successor to R_n
factorisation_test.input_witness: two exact states x,y with R_n(x)=R_n(y) but H_n(x) != H_n(y)
factorisation_test.natural_read: a same-R/different-H pair has different enabled action labels, action multiplicity, or projected R successor Counter under the same admitted action language
factorisation_test.pass_on_panel: the projected action-successor Counters are equal for every same-R/different-H witness in the frozen panel
factorisation_test.separator: store the first action-label/R-successor Counter key with differing multiplicity

l2_boundary_adapter.reason: the compact O7+ carrier does not by itself preserve an authoritative T_X reconstruction map for every nested occurrence
l2_boundary_adapter.rule: do not synthesize a map from an O-carrier to the original complete finite-L2 macro boundary relation T_X

legacy_blind_control.disposition: presentation/provenance read in the scout sampling implementation; not itself an earned operational topology read
legacy_blind_control.known_sampling_read: v0.26 LiftState.reserve_external chooses a child using child.construction_digest
legacy_blind_control.parallel_policy: future exact-carrier lane runs beside, not instead of, the blind O14+ control lane

nonclaims: No new topology-aware action or guard is introduced.
A bounded panel PASS is not a theorem that all exact H_n factor through R_n.
Synthetic O10+ exact-carrier scout states are not graduated O-levels.
No geometry, dimension, physical propagation, or cosmology is inferred.
No hidden pre-O7 topology is reconstructed from the compact O6 resource carrier.
No original L2 macro boundary T_X is invented when the exact adapter data is absent.
const.principle: DO_NOT_ADD_A_READ_LAW. Remove the assumption that R_n is sufficient during computation. Preserve exact H_n first, execute the existing relation-add operation on H_n, and only then project successors to R_n.
const.question: When O_(n+1) is constructed from exact O_n carriers, do already-admitted legal actions naturally depend on exact hierarchical organization that the inherited GRRL resource quotient R_n discards?

state_layers.H_n: exact retained hierarchical carrier available to Decoder, preserving O7+ top incidence and explicit higher-level endpoint reservations
state_layers.R_n: inherited GRRL resource skin / nested bag quotient used by the blind control lane
state_layers.presentation: serialization and construction metadata; differences here alone are never scientific H differences

stopping.no_read_by_budget: UNRESOLVED, never a universal no-read theorem
